title: Sri Lanka Heritage Family
headline: Sigiriya at an easy pace, then Kandy and Colombo.
description: Six nights for a family: three in the cultural triangle, two in Kandy, then Colombo.
image_alt: Nine Arches Bridge and a train in the hills near Ella, Sri Lanka
price_label: Quoted for your family and dates
price_guidance: Family pricing depends on room type, child ages and whether you add Dambulla or a village walk. Site tickets sit outside the base figure unless you ask us to include them.
overview: A heritage-led family week: three nights near Sigiriya so the fortress morning is not rushed, two in Kandy by the lake, then Colombo. Pidurangala or a lower viewpoint can replace the full climb.
highlights: Three nights in the cultural triangle with one fortress morning.
Optional Dambulla caves if energy remains.
Two nights in Kandy and the Temple of the Tooth.
A last Colombo night before the flight.
why: Three stays, with time to recover between sites.
Climbs and site time can be cut for younger children.
The same driver stays with you on the circuit.
inclusions: Accommodation on twin or family-room sharing as quoted
exclusions: Site tickets and safari jeeps unless added
Personal expenses, GST and tourism fees

stay.name: Selected family-friendly hotels on a three-stop circuit
stay.room: Twin, double or interconnecting rooms as available

notes: Climb choice and any extra site are confirmed in writing. Some sites close in heavy rain. An inquiry is not a booking.
itinerary_note: Suggested family order through Sigiriya, Kandy and Colombo. A cultural night can be dropped for a beach close.
